name: Stemcup
summary: Small ceramics of simple shape can be made in one piece. But larger or more complex forms usually have to be made in parts and assembled. Components, such as the 'stem' of this cup, are normally made separately and 'luted' to the body using slip (liquid clay) to form a bond.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
